phase: Phase C7-I - lunar solid tide in F2's propagation and a nonlinear refit of the LRO arc with F2p's recipe
written: 2026-11-01, after C7 (804f9e8: C7_TIDE_MATERIAL, linear share 0.64, K 0.0745 -> 0.0395) and before any C7-I code or number
change: F2's study-level propagation (Problem._propagate_empirical: production RHS + empirical acceleration, DOP853 with shadow-event segmentation) gets one more term: the C7 elastic tide acceleration, raising bodies Earth and Sun from the Problem's own ephemeris (eph.earth_position / eph.sun_position, the third-body inputs F2 already uses), GM from the Problem (mu_e, mu_s), degrees 2 and 3 with GL1800F's k2 = 0.024223 and k3 = 0.0163, R = 1738 km. Applied by a module-level substitution in the C7-I driver (worker processes re-import it), so dynamics.py, F2's script and F2p's records are untouched. The tide is a fixed model (not estimated)
fit: exactly F2p's recipe (main_f2p): N = 300, range + counted Doppler, F2o edits, n_emp = 4, F2H_PRIORS, historical numerics, rtol / atol 1e-12 / 1e-13, legacy LM with relative GN stationarity 1e-3, resumable checkpoint; fit days 260-262, predict 263; start = F2p's own start (F2h S1 x0) so that only the force model differs

gates.G_OFF: with the tide scale set to 0 the substituted propagation reproduces F2's original _propagate_empirical bit for bit over the first 2 h of the arc at F2p's parameters
gates.G_LIN: the nonlinear tide effect (propagation at F2p's parameters with the tide minus F3's cached F2p history, 260-263) matches C7's linear tide column to <= max(0.1 m, 2 % of its max) in position
gates.G3: fit range RMS <= 2 m and Doppler RMS <= 5 mm/s

scores: F2's prediction block on 263 (range / Doppler RMS and mean, RIC vs LOLA), fit-arc RIC vs LOLA, K_SRP, biases, C_T / S_T with formal sigma; 263 chi2 = n_r rms_r^2 + n_d (rms_d / 2 mm/s)^2 (F3c's definition) against F2p's 69 981
decision_rule: G_OFF, G_LIN, G1 or G3 FAIL -> C7I_NOT_QUALIFIED. Otherwise H_PRED -> C7I_TIDE_CONFIRMED; H_K only -> C7I_TIDE_PARTIAL; neither -> C7I_TIDE_NOT_CONFIRMED
reading_rule: C7I_TIDE_CONFIRMED makes the tide part of the LRO reference model from here on (F2t = F2p + tide becomes the reference fit) and a production implementation (lunar_od force model, owner decision on dynamics.py freeze) is proposed; LOLA comparisons are reported, never used for the decision
